words.definition: an activity that you do for fun in your free time.
words.example: Painting is her favorite hobby.

words.definition: free time when you are not working.
words.example: He spends his leisure time reading.

words.definition: to rest and stop worrying or feeling tense.
words.example: I like to relax with a cup of tea.

words.definition: to move your body to stay healthy and fit.
words.example: She exercises every morning before work.

words.definition: a musical performance for an audience.
words.example: We saw our favorite band at the concert.

words.definition: a place where you go to watch films.
words.example: Let's go to the cinema tonight.

words.definition: a building where interesting old objects are kept for people to see.
words.example: The museum has dinosaur bones.

words.definition: a public show of art or interesting objects.
words.example: We visited an art exhibition last week.

words.definition: a special event with music, food, or other activities.
words.example: The town holds a food festival every June.

words.definition: a game played on a flat board with pieces or cards.
words.example: We played a board game after dinner.

words.definition: a list of songs chosen to play together.
words.example: I made a new playlist for the gym.

words.definition: to pay regularly to use a service or receive something.
words.example: He subscribed to a sports channel.

words.definition: watching or listening to something online without downloading it.
words.example: Streaming services offer thousands of films.

words.definition: Saturday and Sunday.
words.example: We usually visit family at the weekend.

words.definition: outside, not in a building.
words.example: The children love playing outdoors.

words.definition: inside a building.
words.example: It was raining, so we stayed indoors.

words.definition: to become a member of a group or club.
words.example: She joined a dance club last year.

words.definition: a group of people who play a sport or work together.
words.example: He plays for the school football team.

words.definition: enjoyable and fun to watch or do.
words.example: The show was really entertaining.

words.definition: feeling tired because something is not interesting or there is nothing to do.
words.example: The children got bored on the long journey.

text: On weekdays, Diego works hard, but he always looks forward to his free time at the weekend. His main hobby is music: he made a long playlist of his favorite songs and listens to it while he exercises in the park. He also subscribes to a streaming service, so he can watch films at home instead of going to the cinema every time. Last Saturday, Diego felt a little bored at home, so he decided to go outdoors instead of staying indoors all day. He went to a museum in the morning and saw an interesting exhibition about ancient history. In the afternoon, he met his friends and they played a board game together — it was very entertaining, and everyone laughed a lot. In the evening, Diego went to a concert with his sister. Next month, there is a big music festival in the city, and Diego wants to join a group of friends who are going. He thinks leisure time is important because it helps him relax after a busy week. He also plans to join a football team to get more exercise and meet new people.
